question_stem: The incomplete nuclear equation for one possible reaction that takes place in the core of a nuclear reactor is $$^{235}_{92}\text{U} + ^{1}_{0}\text{n} \rightarrow ^{139}_{57}\text{La} + ^{95}_{42}\text{Mo} + 2^{1}_{0}\text{n} + ................$$

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: State the name given to this type of nuclear reaction.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem: The mass defect for the reaction is $0.223\text{ u}$.
parts.text: Calculate the energy, in $\text{J}$, equivalent to $0.223\text{ u}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest **two** forms of the energy released in this reaction.
